about_html:
Drop a piece on the board, and every cell it covers flips. Light the whole board to win. That's all there is to it!

Blokkit is a stress-free and tactile logic puzzle about placing chunky blocks on small boards. Each level hands you a fixed set of pieces and a board to light up. Pieces flip whatever they touch but the puzzle is never where a piece fits, it's what order and what overlap leave every tile activated.

Nine different worlds

Your journey runs from Meadow to the Finale through 81 puzzles of increasing complexity. Worlds introduce new board shapes and new mechanics:

  • Frozen cells that soak up the first cover before they'll flip

  • Coupled cells that flip their partner too

  • Boards that wrap around the edges

  • Pieces that spin after every move

  • Conveyor belts that shift the board while you work

One board for the whole world

Every day there is one seeded Daily Puzzle, identical for everyone, everywhere. You get a single attempt, ranked by time on a global leaderboard. Keep your streak alive and see how your morning coffee solve stacks up.

Puzzles that never run out

Finish a world and its Endless Mode opens: infinitely generated boards built from that world's mechanics, perfect for winding down. Feeling up for a challenge? Endless Arcade starts a time bank where every solve buys you more seconds, boards keep coming, and mechanics stack up until the clock finally wins. Then if you really want to wind down, the Endless Zen mode provides endless puzzles, built to your own design, without timers or goals.Â Â 

Made to feel good

  • 81 puzzles across 9 colorful worlds

  • Solvable with logic

  • A Daily Puzzle

  • Endless generated puzzles for every world you finish

  • Endless Arcade time-bank runs to challenge yourself

  • Endless Zen mode with no time limits and your own selection of size and mechanics to destress yourself

  • Unlimited undo, instant restarts, no timers outside arcade

  • Full controller support

  • Full Steam Deck support

Welcome To Violence.


Step into the role of an up-and-coming bareknuckle fighter and climb from illegal underground fights to the biggest stage in bareknuckle boxing. Every victory earns money to improve your abilities, upgrade your gym and prepare for tougher opponents, but every cut and bruise adds to the cumulative damage that will eventually end your career.

Fight Smart.

Inspired by the best of traditional boxing games, Blood & Canvas is the first game built entirely around bareknuckle boxing. Every exchange matters. Manage your stamina, control the distance, pick your shots, and protect yourself at all times. Someone will get their face broken—don't let it be you.



From Underground To The Championship.

Battle your way through three underground venues, earn your place among seasoned professionals and fight toward the championship - if your career lasts long enough.

TAKE THE TERRITORY. BUILD THE ARMY. RULE THE ARENA.


Bloody Fighters is a fast, brutal action-strategy game where comic-book gangs fight for control of industrial arenas. Drag-select squads, capture reinforcement relays, set attack-move waypoints, crack enemy strongholds, and turn every takedown into the next evolution of your army.

FIGHT SOLO OR ONLINE


Conquer a full district campaign, configure custom AI Battles, jump into skill-matched Quick Games, or host Steam lobbies for up to eight players. Hosted arenas support map and player-count settings, passwords, chat, selectable colors, AI-filled slots, Steam invitations, rich presence, and the Steam Overlay.

BUILD YOUR FIGHTING STYLE


Choose from five distinct archetypes: the heavy-hitting Slugger, agile Skirmisher, armored Meatwall, life-stealing Butcher, or fire-spewing Pyromaniac. Kills and captures fill the Blood Meter, opening real-time upgrade drafts with branching weapons, specialist roles, stronger reinforcements, and faction-wide mutations.

EARN SUPERWEAPONS


Every victory awards a random permanent consumable for your offline or online arsenal. Turn a collapsing front with the War Horn, Artillery Barrage, Blood Moon, Reinforcement Drop, EMP Blackout, Titan Contract, or Dead Man's Switch.

PROCEDURAL INDUSTRIAL WARZONES


Battle across the Steam Refinery, Rail Foundry, Clockwork Ruin, and Canal Works. Reproducible seeds vary routes, obstacles, territory placement, Titan opportunities, and tactical pressure, while arena size scales from compact duels to sprawling eight-player wars.

KEY FEATURES


  • A full territory-conquest campaign with persistent progression
  • Custom AI Battles for 2, 4, 6, or 8 factions
  • Online PvP with skill matching, hosted lobbies, Steam invitations, and AI fill
  • Five fighter archetypes with branching weapon and upgrade paths
  • Seven permanent consumable Superweapons earned by winning matches
  • Relay domination and headquarters annihilation victory paths
  • Four procedural industrial arenas with configurable size and seed
  • Readable squad controls, attack-move waypoints, minimap, and live scoreboard
  • Stylized comic-book impacts, blood, gore, and persistent battlefield damage

A first-person sci-fi survival horror game set in a research facility hiding a classified underground complex overrun by an evolving parasitic organism. Explore abandoned laboratories, uncover buried secrets, and fight to survive a nightmare that's spreading from the inside out.

A routine assignment inside a government research facility turns into a desperate fight for survival after a classified biological experiment spirals out of control. As the infection spreads through the underground complex, every floor reveals new secrets, desperate survivors, and increasingly dangerous mutations.

Explore

  • Descend through interconnected underground research sectors.

  • Discover environmental storytelling that reveals the facility's dark history.

  • Recover documents, recordings, and hidden clues to uncover the truth.

Survive

  • Manage limited resources in a hostile environment.

  • Face tense encounters with evolving parasite-infected creatures.

  • Balance exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving to progress deeper into the facility.

Features

  • First-person sci-fi survival horror.

  • Atmospheric underground research facility.

  • Story-driven campaign with environmental storytelling.

  • Exploration, puzzles, and strategic combat.

  • Unique parasite-infected enemies.

  • Immersive lighting and sound design.

Lightus is an open-world role-playing + simulation game. You will play as a traveler with no "past". When exploring the unfamiliar continent of "Theover", you can also discovering lost ruins across the world, searching for lost memories, and creating a new world together with other travelers.

——

Once you step onto the continent of Theover, your adventure begins...

——Run and explore freely across the continent of Theover.

Travel through the Wedge Rift, Serpent Creek, Oran Valley, and Misty Gorge... Immerse yourself in the lush forests, tranquil lakes, and green meadows. Feel the sunlight spread across the land, and the breeze gently brushing your face. As the sun rises and sets, and the songs of birds and the whispers of insects fill the air, craft a world that belongs to you on this land!

Careful tending increases the chances of growing giant crops, striving to become the best farm owner! Different flower colors can also be refined into dyes, allowing you to dye beautiful furniture!

——Capture partners to work for you.

Tired of making furniture? No time to tend to crops? No worries! Partners are here to help! Theover is rich in species, with creatures like the Bobo the radish-head, the Armored Axe Bear, and Night Spirit the butterfly elf. Hunt and capture partners to work for you! They’ll accompany you on adventures, fight monsters, and explore Theover together!

This labyrinth shows no mercy. When you fall, your consciousness transfers to your loyal drone. Return to the revival center, unlock the keyed door to teleport into the next combat arena, and unleash devastating headshots with your rifle to harvest enemy souls.

Trapped in a dark cyberpunk labyrinth. Destroy enemies to clear locked paths, collect falling souls to fill your Ultimate bar, and unleash devastating firepower.

The year is 928. More than two decades have passed since the fall of Nanzhao;
power has changed hands again and again, and no new dynasty yet holds.

Near Jizu Mountain, the road splits three ways. Whether they travel for trade or flee for their lives,
those crossing the mountains stop here for the night.

At the fork stands a nameless inn. You are its keeper.

You boil the water, lay out the food, light the lamps, and receive your guests. You do not question them—
there is no need, and no place for it.

You only watch, and listen, in the spaces between pouring tea and
banking the fire.
Everyone who steps through the door carries a past. Some will tell it; most will not.

And yet, on one night or another, you come to see who they truly are.

“How can a man hide what he is?” — The Analects

Those who walk the rivers and lakes seldom show their hand. Even when a name is given,

it is not always one to be trusted.

The cut of a coat, the weight of a pack, the room he chooses, the dish he calls for,

the half-word that slips out over idle talk — none of it escapes your eye.

Some rest a single night and are gone; some stay on for days. And some go and come again,

and this time bring up at last the half-sentence they swallowed before.

“An inn for all things under heaven” — Li Bai

The common room or a room of one’s own, beneath the eaves or in the stable —

every guest sleeps after his own fashion.

The poor man wants only to spare his coin; the rich merchant wants only quiet.

As for the one who carries a blade, he will not close his eyes until his back is to the wall.

The same room may gladden one guest and set another frowning the moment he steps in.

Every dish and every cup is entered, stroke by stroke, into the ledger. When the doors are barred for the night,

you settle the day on the abacus, bead by bead.

And mark this: the hours of a day are few. Do one thing, and another goes undone.

“Should I seek a good buyer and sell it?” — The Analects

A woodcutter’s dry firewood, a tea merchant’s samples, rare herbs and curios carried from distant lands.

Whether the goods are fine or poor, honestly come by or not, rests on the sharpness of your eye.

What the inn holds may also pass to those who lack it. But what a man truly lacks, you must hear for yourself.

Given time, men will come proposing a partnership: you entrust them your capital, they go a long road,

and months later they return — or never return at all.

“The third bowl ransacks my barren mind” — Lu Tong

Over tea and talk, when a guest’s spirits rise, he is bound to quote the classics and put the innkeeper to the test.

Every question has its source. Four answers lie before you; the wrong ones are real enough in this world,

only set in the wrong place.

Some questions no amount of worldly wisdom will answer; you must have a few scrolls in your belly.

All you have seen, heard and read is gathered into one volume: A Miscellany of Wayfarers from Yeyu.

From forms of address and implements to food and prices, to mountains, rivers and place names —

whatever can be verified has its source.

“Comes at midnight, gone by dawn” — Bai Juyi

Bolt the door at closing, and the day is not always done.

Sometimes, deep in the night, there comes a tapping at the gate. Sometimes, when enough guests are gathered,

the dice are cast for a round of Caixuan Ge, the game of official ranks: from the lowliest clerk each player throws his way upward, and each throws out a career of rises and falls.

Now and then a guest takes lodging, and the longer you look, the less right it sits. Turn it over as you will,

something of the hearth’s warmth is missing from him.

You only pour the tea. The Master did not speak of prodigies, feats of strength, disorder, or spirits.

“How many times has the world grieved for things gone by” — Liu Yuxi

News from beyond the mountains reaches the inn days late, and changed along the way.

Idle talk from guests, old matters set down in books — pieced together scrap by scrap, the world on the map lights up, one place after another.

Fair today, rain tomorrow; and so the travelers on the road are many or few, and of every sort.

As for how the histories will be written, that is the historians’ business.

Whether what you do accords with history or defies it — who can say?

BoQiong: Warlords Vie for the Realm is a 2–4 player online turn-based strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms. Expand your domain, recruit officers, trade with rival warlords, and roll the ancient BoQiong dice to decide battles and unexpected events.

Forge alliances when it suits you—but always be wary of betrayal from your allies. Negotiate, deceive, bribe, and outmaneuver your rivals—then seize the provinces you need to claim victory.

Multiplayer Battle and Diplomacy

In an age of rival warlords, today's ally may be tomorrow's greatest threat.

Join forces with other players to keep the strongest force in check. Trade cities, officers, and items to complete powerful combinations. Negotiate a truce when you need time to rebuild—or wait until an ally lets their guard down and launch a sudden surprise attack.

Every deal is temporary. Every promise has a price.

There can only be one victor. Use diplomacy, deception, and force to defeat your rivals and unite the realm.

Capture cities. Recruit officers. Collect items

Cities are taken through siege battles, while officers and items are found through Search each turn from a random selection.

Everything you own in this game can all become bargaining chips when dealing with other players.

Certain resources form special Synergies when collected together, granting powerful effects. Build combinations that fit your strategy—or trade with your rivals for the final piece you need.

Roll the BoQiong

At the heart of the game is the BoQiong (博琼, historically 博茕), an eighteen-sided dice used in the Qin and Han periods.

A standard BoQiong features the numbers 1–16 and two special faces: 【Jiao（骄）】 and 【Kui（愧）】.

Every officer has their own unique BoQiong, with different numbers and special faces. In battle, rolling 【Jiao】 raises that officer's level, while 【Kui】 lowers it. A single roll can turn a winning battle into a disaster—or give an underdog the chance to fight back.

Skills and items can also add Marks to individual faces of a BoQiong. Different Marks trigger different effects, allowing you to build new combinations between officers, items, and dice.

Battles with BoQiong Dice

On your turn, launch a siege, choose your officers, arrange your formation, and roll their BoQiong to resolve attacks and skills.

But troop strength alone does not decide the winner.

Every round can bring an unexpected event—and even players who are not fighting can interfere with the battle.

Neutral players may be asked to choose what happens next.

Don't like their choice?

Bribe them.

Offer gold and persuade them to pick the event that helps you instead. A battle between two players can quickly become a contest involving everyone at the table.

Different Modes to Vie for the Realm

This game will feature several modes, each demanding a different approach.

Full Map Mode focuses on long-term expansion and competition between forces.

Province Contest Mode turns a specific province or group of commanderies into the center of the struggle.

Scenario Mode recreates historical conflicts, placing players in control of rival forces as they compete for supremacy across the Central Plains.

Different objectives mean different priorities. Sometimes expansion matters most. Sometimes diplomacy does. And sometimes stopping the player who is one turn away from winning is the only thing that matters.

No match unfolds exactly the same way.

Roads may change from year to year. Items can be lost. Officers may leave your force. Cities may even rebel. During battle, other players can use neutral characters and random events to interfere with your plans.

A sudden disaster can destroy your advantage—but the same chaos may give a weaker force the perfect opportunity to turn the tables.

DEMO

At present, the DEMO version has opened game modes for competing for Jizhou and the Anti Dong Alliance, supporting up to 4 and 8 players to play online respectively. In addition, the single player/online mode has been updated to jointly attack the Sili and Yongzhou occupied by Dong Zhuo's army with friends. Welcome everyone to try it out~

A Note from the Developer

BoQiong: Warlords Vie for the Realm is developed entirely by me as a solo developer. As I currently do not have access to professional localization, some in-game translations are machine-translated and may contain errors or display issues.

I will continue doing my best to improve each language version and polish the game as a whole. If you notice any translation issues or other problems, please feel free to let me know.

Thank you very much for your interest and support!

Line up your army. Watch the battle unfold.

Boardbound Heroes is a roguelike autobattler about raising an army while diving ever deeper into dungeons. Battles play out automatically—your job is everything that comes before: who to recruit, where to place them, what to equip. Command the board, and the board decides the fight.

Features

  • 3×3 tactical placement— Front row tanks, back row damage. With range and movement on the board, positioning itself is your strategy.

  • Classes & trait synergies— Knights, mages, summoners, whip masters and more. Collect distinctive classes and amplify them through trait combinations.

  • Reward card drafts— After key floors, draw 3 cards from a deck you built yourself. Heal now or power up? Your picks shape each run.

  • Equipment & smithing— Hunt gear across 5 rarity tiers, craft with materials, and chase recipes only bosses drop.

  • Idle-friendly— 4x battle speed and auto-farming mode make grinding painless, with a full loot summary when you return.

Your army is an investment

Nothing ends with a single run. Every hero you recruit, every weapon you forge, every card you collect stays with you—and your army grows stronger, step by step. From the monster king lurking beyond the grasslands to the Demon Lord's castle awaiting at the end: your heroes are ready when you are.

Welcome to Bone to Pick: Forensic Case Files.

You are the new trainee at a forensic anthropology lab.

This is where bones with no name and no story end up. A bombing, a riverbed, white bone in an incinerator's ash. Read what the bones say, and give the missing dead their names back. That is your mission.

EXAMINING THE EVIDENCE

Shine the light, run the swab. You've watched those hands on TV. Now they're yours.

CLEANING THE BONE

Nothing starts until the bone is clean. And what's in your sink is not the dishes.

LAYING OUT THE SKELETON

Sometimes the clue is the part that isn't there. Set every bone where it belongs.

REFITTING THE FRAGMENTS

Cases leave bones broken. Fit the pieces back together and find what the damage was hiding.

FIRING THE LASER

Sometimes an identity comes down to one tooth, shaved with a laser. Which is not just for show.

MATCHING THE WEAPON

Compare the mark left at the scene and name the weapon. Want to try all of them? After the case is closed, please.

QUESTIONING THE SUSPECT

Put the bad guys behind bars! Every piece of evidence you find brings you closer to the truth.

Read age, sex, old injuries and cause of death from the bones. Pick diatoms out of river mud under a microscope, cast a tire track or an animal's bite mark, and comb the scene for the evidence everyone else walked past. Forensics takes many forms.

Rigorous science, a warm atmosphere. Not scary, not gruesome — a mystery about people.

FROM THE CASE FILES

Seven cases. Seven names waiting. Every one of them a human being, and a truth.

  • A car explodes on a street in broad daylight. The body inside is burned beyond recognition. Who planted it, and why?

  • Skeletal remains at a construction site. An affair, a shared business, money. Nobody around the victim is without a secret.

  • A body on the riverbank: a young reporter. Was it a source, a rival, or…

  • A body dissolved into sludge. A celebrated photographer's past hides a motive no one knew.

  • Bone burned white in an incinerator's ash — a star hockey player's cruel end. Burn it all and it disappears. Someone must have believed that.

  • A politician's future daughter-in-law, found as bones. A break-in gone wrong, or the son himself? Step into the family's shadow.

  • A college student's death, closed ten years ago as an accident. The team reads it again. The final case.

PEOPLE OF THE LAB AND THE CITY

Between cases, the lab is your other home. Eavesdrop on your colleagues, chase high scores in the minigames, and fill your archive with every bone, colleague and closed case you meet. From the lab to the city, from the city to the edge of town. Every door that opens brings more people to meet.

Dive straight into incoming enemy groups and never stop moving. Dodge attacks with quick moves and clear the area. As each wave gets tougher, use the map to your advantage and stay alive!

Use points earned between rounds to shape your character to your playstyle. Max out your health to become a tank, or boost your damage to wipe out enemies in seconds. Every stat you pick defines your fate in the next wave.

Grab the best cards presented at the end of each wave. Some cards give huge power boosts while taking away armor or speed; balance the risk carefully. Combine the right cards to create an unstoppable build!

You don't have to rely only on your weapons. Turn the battlefield into total chaos with extra skills. Deploy orbiting fireballs, auto-targeting drones, or shockwaves that push enemies back to clear the screen with ease!

A tiny VPet device lives on your desktop, and a pixel pet lives on its screen. Every key you press and every click you make earns a Bongo Point and makes your pet hop. Work, write, chat or play: your pet keeps you company while the points pile up.

Type. Treat. Care.

Every 250 presses a treat drops onto the screen. Feed your pet, check its mood, play the catch game, clean up after it and turn off the light at bedtime, all with the device's own three buttons. A content pet adds a 5% bonus to your points.

A box or a key every 30 minutes

Every 30 minutes of play, a box and a key pop up beside your devices. Pick one for 1,000 Bongo Points: the key, or a box that spins in on its own reel. Every new player starts with a key.

Open it on the reel

Put a key in a box and it bursts open on your desktop. The cards run past, slow down, crawl over the last few and stop on what you got. The odds stand right beside the reel before every opening. In a series box: Common 70%, Rare 22%, Epic 6%, Legendary 1.6%, Mythic 0.4%.


A Mythic find is announced to every player.

7 device series

Classic, Tiny, Bat, Cat, Dino, Link and Rainbow: every series has 20 looks across five rarities and its own box. Rare looks come polished, metallic, holographic or glowing.

Pets, straps and charms

The Pet Box holds 16 pets, each in the classic green LCD look and the rare Color look on a bright backlit screen. The Accessory Box holds straps and charms that swing from your device as you drag it around.

Collect, trade, trade up

Fill your BongoDex with 250 items. Everything is a Steam Inventory item: trade boxes and finds with friends or on the Steam Community Market. Duplicates are kept, and with Trade Up, 10 items of one rarity become one random item of the next.

Features

  • A desktop companion that sits on your taskbar and never steals focus: clicks pass straight through to your desktop.
  • Every key press and click counts. Only the number is kept, never which key.
  • A treat every 250 presses, plus care, a catch mini-game and day and night.
  • A box or a key every 30 minutes of play, opened on a reel with the odds shown.
  • 7 device series with 20 looks each, 32 pet looks, 18 straps and 60 charms.
  • Five rarities, from Common to Mythic.
  • Tradable, marketable Steam Inventory items and a Trade Up contract.
  • A free Bongo Pass: 28-day seasons with 20 tiers of Bongo Points and treats.
  • Up to three devices on your desktop at once.
  • Light on your PC: it idles at a few frames per second.
  • Steam Achievements, 29 languages.
  • Free to Play. Keys and Random Boxes can also be bought in the in-game store.

Every belt has a division. Every division has a story.

Booker Blitz is a wrestling promotion management sim where you're the booker. You sign the talent, build the title picture, cut the promos and book the card. When the show goes live, you're still in the chair.

Built for the keyboard

Booker Blitz is keyboard-centric, with a command palette for getting around fast. It runs on Windows and Linux and is 100% playable on Steam Deck (Valve review pending).

Title divisions

Championships run weight-class or custom divisions, each with its own standings, win-loss records, streaks and form. Every division keeps a number-one contender, and you book the title shot or the contendership match straight from the Match Wizard. Offer a division spot at the contract table, put one wrestler in several divisions, and watch rival promotions build theirs and schedule their own defences.

Titles only change hands on a pinfall or submission. A DQ or count-out keeps the belt where it is, and prestige rises and falls with match quality and how often you put the title on TV.

Gorilla Position

Most booking sims stop at the bell. In Booker Blitz you stay in the chair while the show runs. Change the winner, call the finisher, or send in a run-in, a distraction, a weapon spot or manager interference, live. Use it when the moment needs it. Call every spot and the crowd cools off.

A show that talks back

  • Simulation feed. Every match plays out live with commentary, crowd reactions and injury reports.

  • Commentary booth. Your announce team calls matches and segments in their own voice.

  • Segment Wizard. Build promos beat by beat. Pick who speaks, who they're targeting, and which writers help, and lock the narration lines you want.

  • Tournaments. Brackets with half-star match ratings, from one to five stars.

Run the company

  • Brand Rosters. Split talent across brands and move them in batches.

  • Talent desk. Bookmark favorites, check win-loss records and division stats, and book squash matches with suggested durations.

  • Contracts. Pay talent monthly or per appearance, decide separately whether they're exclusive, and fight off poaching from rival promotions.

  • Show finances. Every show has its own books: arena fees, line-item costs, merch, sponsor profit per segment and projected profit, plus finance charts over six months, a year or your full run.

  • Scouting and training. Scouts uncover talent you don't know yet, and trainers develop Charisma, Mic and Hardcore.

  • Arena gallery. Pick your venues when you start a new game and filter them by territory.

Make the world yours

  • Datapacks with portraits, logos and belt art. Check out the website for community themes and datapacks

  • TEW and PWS converter. Bring your existing databases over as datapacks. TEW imports also bring their arenas and venue pictures.

  • DataStudio is the official editor for building and editing your world.

  • Themes. Use the built-in themes, make your own, or grab more from the official website.

The demo returns at 1.0

More on the official website, .

Booker Blitz is made by David Morais.

[h2]The library is trying to kill you.[/h2]

You're just trying to get out. The books have other plans.

Every shelf is a trap. Get too close to the wrong tome and it dashes straight at you. Walk under another and it drops on your head. Land on a floating book over a bottomless void and it starts sinking the moment your feet touch it — stand still and you go down with it. Some patrol the walls. Some come screaming across the room from the left with no warning at all.

Touch any of them and you die.

[h2]No checkpoints. No mercy.[/h2]

Die and you start the level over from the beginning. Not from a nearby flag. Not from halfway. The beginning. Every death is a full reset, and every level is built to make you earn the exit.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]

[*][b]29 handcrafted levels[/b] of escalating library hostility

[*][b]Five kinds of murderous book[/b], each with its own way of ending your run

[*][b]Precision 3D platforming[/b] — tight controls, no excuses

[*][b]Death restarts the level[/b], so every jump matters

[*][b]It talks back[/b] — the game has opinions about how you died

[/list]

[h2]Built for the clip.[/h2]

This is a game designed to be watched as much as played. If you stream, your chat is going to have a great time. If you don't, no one has to know how many attempts level 19 took.

Short Description (Store card preview, under 280 characters) Boom Cube is a 3D roguelike block elimination game. Break away from traditional 2D Tetris-style gameplay. Manipulate blocks inside a 10×10×10 cubic space, stack and clear layers to create explosive combos. Free Demo available now! Coins earned in the Demo can be carried over to the full game with the same Steam account. Wishlist now for launch updates!

About This Game

Boom Cube

Break the limits of flat block games and step into a cubic world for a brand-new 3D roguelike block elimination experience!

Blocks fall and rotate along X/Y/Z axes. Fill an entire horizontal layer to clear blocks. Consecutive clears trigger combos and Fever mode, unleash various skills for massive board wipes. Border Control Together is a first-person border checkpoint simulator where you and your fellow officers work the same shift in a harsh authoritarian state.

Money can be earned by correctly allowing travelers through the border, arresting smugglers, surrendering confiscated contraband, or accepting bribes.

Balance efficiency, operating expenses, legal income, and corruption while keeping the checkpoint running and giving the Inspectorate no reason to question your performance.

Bouncer is a compact competitive strategy game built around simultaneous decisions. Each player chooses a move, then both moves resolve together. That simple rule turns every turn into a prediction: where is your opponent going, what space are they trying to control, and what happens if your slimes collide?

COLLISIONS CHANGE THE BOARD

When slimes meet, Bouncer's collision rules send the action into a bounce. Pieces can be pushed back through previous spaces as the interaction resolves, creating situations where positioning matters just as much as the move you choose now. A move that looks safe can become dangerous when both players have the same idea.

REACH THE BASE — AND HOLD IT

Getting to the opposing base is only part of the challenge. To win, you need to occupy your opponent's base and still be there when the next turn begins. That gives your rival one last chance to knock you away and makes every attack a contest over both timing and position.

SMALL BOARDS, BIG DECISIONS

Bouncer keeps the play space compact so every move matters. Special board spaces and different layouts can change the safest routes, create new collision opportunities, and force both players to adapt.

FEATURES

• Simultaneous movement: both players commit before the turn resolves.

• Bounce-driven collisions that reward prediction and positioning.

• Compact grid-based boards designed around quick tactical decisions.

• A base-capture objective that gives the defending player a chance to respond.

• Special board spaces and layouts that change how you approach each match.

• Local two-player competitive play.

Every move is simple to make. The hard part is guessing what happens when your opponent moves too.

99 of 100 mechs animated

Every great empire starts with a single shelf.

Convince customers your latest masterpiece is worth every penny.

Make sure your employees stay focused at work.

  • Develop your own games

  • Expand and customize your store

  • Hire and manage employees/developer

  • Open loot boxes and collect skins

  • Create and train an esports team

  • Host arena events and sell tickets

  • Unlock new products and upgrades

Do you have what it takes to become the Bug Fix Billionaire?

BugPot is a casual roguelike built around a deadly slot machine. Spin the reels, match weapons and charms and turn every combination into an attack against a wide variety of bugs.

Every spin gives you something new to work with. Match weapons to deal damage, use charms to shape your strategy, upgrade your weapons, and find powerful combinations that can turn the fight in your favor. But the reels won't always give you what you want. Adapt to what you get, decide how to make the most of each spin, and keep your run alive.

Your weapons are on the reels. Spin the machine and match weapons and charms to build your attack. Every result can open up a different way to approach the fight. Experiment with different weapons and charms, upgrade your weapons, and discover combinations that make each run play differently.

Face a strange collection of bugs, each with their own personality and challenge. Learn what you're up against and adapt your strategy before they bring your run to an end. You can't control what comes up next, but you can control what you do with it. Make the most of every spin, push your luck, and find the setup you need to squash the next bug.

Build traps and race your friends.

BUILD & BAIL is a 3D party platformer for 2-6 players. Before every race, everyone secretly places a trap or platform on the track, then you all race at the same time. Round after round there are more traps in the way and the race gets more chaotic.

How a round works

First, each player selects a piece from a random list of all available pieces.


Then, each player places their piece anywhere on the map.

Once everything is in place, the new pieces are revealed and the race begins.

Features

  • Your track, your chaos New traps arrive every round. By the end, the track is a minefield made of your own ideas.

  • A nasty arsenal Saw blades, pendulums, cannons, wind cannons, jump traps, honey fields, ice patches and more.

  • Snappy movement Double jump, wall jump, dash. Easy to learn, but fast players stay in front.

  • Tracks that go up Candy towers, neon rooftops, glaciers, lava fields, desert ruins. Always with multiple routes and shortcuts.

  • Your rules Score target, rounds, respawns, player collision, sudden death: the host decides how mean it gets.

  • Character workshop Colour, hat, face. Look your best before you fall into the lava.

  • Easy to play together Steam lobbies: invite friends, share a code or open a public lobby.

Short rounds, big schadenfreude. Perfect for a night with friends who might not stay friends.

SHOOT. DODGE. CONTROL THE DISTANCE.

Commandless 1v1 Bullet-Hell Action

Bullet Barrage is a fast-paced 1v1 action game where two fighters fly freely through the arena and overwhelm each other with dense patterns of projectiles.

No complicated command inputs are required.

Shoot.
Dodge.
Create distance.
Rush into your opponent's space.
Use bullet patterns to restrict their movement.
Then punish the opening with your strongest attack.

The controls are simple.
But every decision matters.

Which attack do you use?
Where do you move?
When do you commit?

A single decision can determine the entire fight.

Game controller required.

BATTLE ONLINE

Fight other players through Random Match or Room Match.

Random Match

Automatically search for an opponent and jump straight into battle.

Room Match

Create or join a room and battle a specific player.

Play against the CPU, battle locally with another player, or take the fight online.

Choose how you want to play.

8 CHARACTERS. 8 DIFFERENT WAYS TO FIGHT.

Choose from 8 playable characters, each with their own weapons, projectile patterns, preferred range, and combat style.

Pressure your opponent with rapid-fire attacks.
Snipe from long range.
Control the arena with dense bullet patterns.
Deploy support weapons and remote units.
Force your way into close range.

Every character approaches battle differently.

Find the fighter that matches your style and build your own strategy.

ATTACKS — CONTROL WHERE YOUR OPPONENT CAN MOVE

Combat revolves around several offensive options, including:

Main / Sub 1 / Sub 2 / Special

Winning is not simply about firing as many bullets as possible.

Block escape routes.
Force a dodge.
Move your opponent where you want them.
Then place the next attack directly in their path.

Combine different projectile patterns to gradually take away your opponent's freedom of movement.

Do not just aim at your opponent. Control the space around them.

DODGE — BREAK THROUGH THE BARRAGE

Read the incoming bullets and move through them.

Use:

Dash / Guard / Bomb

to survive enemy attacks and regain control of the fight.

Dash is not only an evasive tool.

It can also close distance instantly and bring the battle into your preferred range.

Avoid the barrage.
Create space.
Then take that space back in an instant.

Offense, defense, and spacing are all connected.

ENERGY — ATTACK, DEFEND, OR SAVE IT

Attacking, dashing, and guarding all interact with your energy resources.

Spend too much and you may have nothing left when you truly need it.

Save too much and your opponent may take control of the battle.

Use it now?
Or preserve it for the next exchange?

Managing your resources is just as important as controlling the battlefield.

COMMANDLESS — NO COMPLEX INPUTS REQUIRED

You do not need to memorize complicated directional commands to perform powerful attacks.

Each action is activated directly through its assigned button.

The challenge is not:

“Can you perform the move?”

The challenge is:

“When should you use it?”

Battle through positioning, projectile control, resource management, and decision-making rather than complicated input execution.

PLAY SOLO, LOCAL, OR ONLINE

Fight CPU-controlled opponents and learn each character at your own pace.

Challenge another player through local versus.

Take the battle online through Random Match or Room Match.

Steam Remote Play Together is also supported for local-style remote play.

Use the tutorial to learn the fundamentals.

Enter training mode to study your character.

Then step into battle.

STORY MODE

The full version is planned to include a Story Mode featuring the characters and conflicts behind the battles.

Fight through their encounters and discover what lies beyond the barrage.

LANGUAGE

Supports English and Japanese.

The initial language is automatically selected based on your Steam language setting and can be changed at any time from the in-game CONFIG menu.

EMBRACE THE BARRAGE.

In search of adventure, you and your friends set out to explore an abandoned mine. After a sudden collapse, you become separated from the group and, while searching for a way back to the surface, discover something that should never have existed.

Deep beneath the earth lies a secret Soviet research complex whose existence was never officially acknowledged. Decades ago, the facility was completely isolated from the outside world, and all information about the experiments conducted there vanished without a trace.

Explore abandoned laboratories and tunnels as you uncover the history of the complex. Project Collie was created to grant a living creature intelligence and freedom from death.

The deeper you descend underground, the more questions arise. Why was the complex sealed off? What happened to its personnel? And is everything buried beneath the mountain truly dead?

Buried Life is an atmospheric first-person adventure featuring exploration, puzzles, and psychological horror elements.

Features

• An abandoned Soviet research complex hidden from the outside world for decades.

• The secrets of Project Collie and Project Newtonia, buried deep underground.

• Exploration of laboratories, mines, and technical tunnels.

• Documents, tapes, and recordings that reveal the fate of the complex.

• Interactive environments and hidden secrets.

• Choices that influence the outcome of the story.

• An atmospheric adventure with psychological horror elements.
